newsitem.title: DENMARK: DANISH BOND PRICES FIRM AFTER BUBA REPO.
newsitem.headline: DANISH BOND PRICES FIRM AFTER BUBA REPO.

text.p: Key Danish bond prices rose in early trade on Tuesday, with investors relieved at the Bundesbank's decision to keep its repo rate at an unchanged three percent.

The Danish benchmark eight percent state bond due 2006 traded up 0.21 point from Monday's close at 112.66 at 0805 GMT, with the yield at 6.08 percent. The seven percent bond due 2007, due to take over as benchmark on September 1, was 0.22 point higher at 105.56, yielding 6.27 percent .
The 2007's 10-year yield gap with Germany widened four basis points to 62 bps.
The crown stood at 3.8091 per mark, weakening from Monday's late 3.8085.
